svg.text: E-002 MAIN DC DISTRIBUTION AND PROPULSION FEEDERS
Independent conceptual study — unbuilt and unvalidated.
Main DC distribution and propulsion feeders
Prepared for: Pratik Prabhakar Shinde | AI-assisted independent study
DXF generated with Python. Not drafted or validated inside AutoCAD.
POWER CIRCUITS / SIMPLIFIED DEVICE SYMBOLS / ALL CONTACTS SHOWN DE-ENERGIZED
C02: 2 x 10 mm2 / 3 m one way
C03: 2 x 10 mm2 / 3 m one way
I = P / 22.4 V; Rloop = 2 L rho / A
Wire numbers identify conductors, not vendor pins.
No dot at wire crossing = no connection.
HOLD: cable ampacity / battery fault current / fuse interrupt rating and selectivity / ESC inrush, UV and regeneration.
Switchgear voltage rating >=60 V DC is a target; actual DC breaking capability and fault withstand must be checked.
